Things men learn too
late about friendship
Friendships need a plan after school. Nobody sees you every day anymore. If you don't book the dinner or the trip, months pass without seeing the people you love.
You can be the one who reaches out first, every time. It's not weakness. Most guys are waiting for someone else to send the first message. Be that person.
Telling a friend you're proud of him matters. Men rarely say it out loud. One honest sentence can mean more to him than you will ever know, and he'll never forget it.
Old friends don't need constant contact. Some friendships survive years of silence and pick up instantly. Treasure those, and call them anyway, just because.
Before: catch-ups were always the same old stories. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and something new to share with friends each time.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: catch-ups were always the same old stories. After: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Now I bring something new to share each time.

slides.texte_overlay: Doing things together builds more than talking. Football, fishing, a road trip. Many men bond side by side, and shared adventures become the best stories you have.
The friends who tell you the truth are the ones to keep. Anyone can clap for you. The friend who says "I think you're making a mistake" is a rare gift.
